items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That other tune was what, Poe Nelly? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Hoey Nelly. Hoey Nelly. H-O-Y-E. Hoey Nelly.

ctx.x: That other tune was what, Poe Nelly?
Hoey Nelly. Hoey Nelly. H-O-Y-E. Hoey Nelly.
I don't think they issued that then. I don't think that came out, did it?
